name: Barreling Attack — +1/+1 for each creature blocking it, the number entered by hand
notes: Sweep group 7 (2026-10-07). "When that creature becomes blocked this turn, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each creature blocking it" opened with "When", so on a spell it was skipped as a trigger. It is now read as the next thing that happens to the spell's target. Who blocks whom is not recorded, so the count is a number typed on the spell's row (params.byHandCount, kept as the row's cdaUserValue and saved with the board). Two blockers: the Bears are 4/4 with trample.
